title: Final Wavelength
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct numerical value for the longest wavelength, which is approximately 110 Å.

title: Energy Level Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the energy levels for the ground state and the first excited state using the provided formula.

title: Transition Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the energy difference between the ground state and the first excited state.

title: Use of Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly use physical constants such as h (Planck's constant) and c (speed of light) in their calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid unit mistakes, particularly in converting energy units to wavelength units.

title: Assumption Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide justification for assuming the electrons are in the ground state at room temperature.
